captions.linkedin:
A lot of good candidates don't get found for a simple reason: they describe their work in their own words, and the job description uses different ones.

"Found why repeat purchases dropped" is retention analysis. But if a recruiter searches the ATS for "retention analysis", that resume doesn't come up.

QuickFit CV compares your resume with the job, shows which of its keywords are missing, and puts them into the lines that already prove them. It doesn't add keywords for work you haven't done.
